mapper.select: SELECT l.id, l.track, l.seq, l.title, l.judge_type, l.is_optional, p.completed_at FROM lessons l LEFT JOIN lesson_progress p ON p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.lesson_id = l.id WHERE l.track = #{track} AND l.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY l.seq

SELECT l.id, l.track, l.seq, l.title, l.judge_type, l.is_optional, l.content_json, p.completed_at FROM lessons l LEFT JOIN lesson_progress p ON p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.lesson_id = l.id WHERE l.id = #{lessonId} AND l.status = 'PUBLISHED'
